entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Hey, it can't be true, can it!?[n]Please tell me you're OK!

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: That suicide report was all over[n]the news, and Ms. Kawakami said[n]you went back to your hometown...

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: I was honestly worried[n]about contacting you...

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Even Sakamoto was dodging the[n]question when I tried to ask him.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: But don't worry.[n]I won't tell anyone!

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: By the way, the Phan-Site[n]is a real mess right now...

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: But I'll keep supporting you[n]from the shadows! Good luck!
